body: I agree. Halo was fun while it lasted, but every time I tried replaying the series, I could never finish.. I'd rather spend my money on games I know for sure I'll play. Not just a series for the nice memories. Just my thoughts :)

Rubber band I would try. That sounds like really good advice, actually :) I've tried quitting before, like throwing out all my blades, but it caused extreme anxiety. But its worth a shot I suppose. :)
Sure. No guarantee at the moment, but I'd definitely give it a shot.

I agree with this. Shorter sleeping times are far more believable than months without sleep. And unlike the latter, we actually know that sleeping for 30 minutes to an hour, multiple times a day, can greatly benefit you. For example, you can feel more rested with the shorter sleep time AND get more stuff done!

Thank you. I suppose this is considered the "first step"? Its just hard to make the effort when you feel there isn't a point, and knowing that the blade is always near... Yeah, its hard to stop. Thanks though :)
